title: Palacio de Deportes de la Comunidad de Madrid

Palacio de Deportes de la Comunidad de Madrid (English: "Community of Madrid Sports Centre"), since November 2016 called WiZink Center for sponsorship reasons, is an indoor sporting arena located in Madrid, Spain. Its capacity is 15,000 people for basketball matches and 15,500 for concerts (with standing public ramp).

title: 2014 FIBA Basketball World Cup Final

The 2014 FIBA Basketball World Cup Final was a basketball game that took place on 14 September 2014 at Palacio de Deportes de la Comunidad de Madrid in Madrid, Spain, to determine the winner of the 2014 FIBA Basketball World Cup.
